The Company’s Class A ordinary shares will begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on The Nasdaq Capital Market at the open of trading on July 31, 2026, under the existing symbol “OFAL” with a new CUSIP number, G6713S114. At the effective time, every ten (10) issued Class A ordinary shares will automatically be consolidated into one (1) Class A ordinary share, reducing the number of issued and outstanding Class A ordinary shares from 26,370,521 to approximately 2,637,052 (subject to rounding for fractional shares). No fractional shares will be issued in connection with the Share Consolidation.
